players.bio: Alfie Pond is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League Two club Chesterfield F.C.. He signed a permanent contract with the club on 6 July 2026, keeping him with the Spireites until the summer of 2028.
Connor Paul Cook (born 14th July 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Chesterfield. He is also the son of his club's manager Paul Cook.

Danny Braian Ambato Anisjko (also spelled Danni Aņisjko) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for English EFL League Two club Chesterfield FC. Born in England to an Ecuadorian mother and a Latvian father, he represents Latvia internationally at the youth level.

Dilan Kumar Markanday (born 20 August 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right winger for EFL League Two club Chesterfield. Career Markanday is a youth academy graduate of Tottenham Hotspur. On 19 January 2021, he extended his contract with the club until June 2022.
Dylan Duffy (born 28 November 2002) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a winger for Chesterfield.
Fraser Bryden (born Jun 1, 2004) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a Centre-Forward for Chesterfield FC

George James McEachran (born 30 August 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Chesterfield. He is the younger brother of fellow footballer Josh McEachran.

Jack Benjamin Simpson (born 18 December 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League Two club Chesterfield. He began his career at AFC Bournemouth, where he made 35 appearances, including 11 in the Premier League, and scored one goal. In January 2021, he joined Rangers, where he won a Scottish Premiership title.

Joel Randall is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Chesterfield in EFL League Two, on loan from EFL Championship club Bolton Wanderers. Career Despite being a boyhood Southampton fan, Joel joined the Exeter City Academy at U11's after being spotted at one of the club's development centres.

Josh Koroma is a 27-year-old professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for EFL League Two club Chesterfield, on loan from EFL League One club Leyton Orient. Career Koroma was born in Southwark, London. He made his first-team debut for Leyton Orient on 9 April 2016 as a second-half substitute in a 3–0 league defeat away to Barnet.
Junior Eccleston (born 22 April 2007) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for English League Two club Chesterfield F.C.
Kyle John McFadzean (born 20 February 1987) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre back for EFL League Two club Chesterfield.
Lee Bonis (born 3 August 1999) is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League Two club Chesterfield and the Northern Ireland national team.

Lewis Courtney Gordon (born 12 February 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a left back for EFL League Two club Chesterfield. Gordon is a product of the Watford academy and he began his professional career with the club. Following two seasons with Brentford B, Gordon's professional career began in earnest with Bristol Rovers in 2022. He was capped by Scotland at youth level.

Liam Mandeville (born 17 February 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as winger for EFL League Two club Chesterfield. Career Mandeville made his first team debut for Doncaster Rovers on 3 April 2015, coming on as a second-half substitute for Jonson Clarke-Harris in a home League One match against Bradford City at the Keepmoat Stadium.
Louie Marsh is a 22-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a forward for Chesterfield F.C. on loan from Sheffield United F.C..
Abdul-Malik Justin Owolabi-Belewu (born 3 July 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Chesterfield in EFL League Two.

Paul Anthony Cook (born 22 February 1967) is an English professional football manager and former player who is currently manager of National League side Chesterfield. Cook played as a central midfielder during a playing career that spanned 23 years from 1983 until 2006, notably in the Premier League for Coventry City.

Remeao Andrew Hutton is an English professional footballer who plays as a full back for Chesterfield. Hutton spent several years in Walsall's academy before being released while still a schoolboy. He played for Sutton Coldfield Town's under-21 team, and joined Hednesford Town's academy as part of his college course.
Ruel Sotiriou is a 25-year-old professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Chesterfield Football Club.

Ryan Thomas William Boot (born 9 November 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Chesterfield. He turned professional at Port Vale in April 2013 and played on loan at Worcester City, Norton United, Newcastle Town, and Macclesfield Town.

Ryan William Stirk (born 25 September 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Chesterfield. . He spent the 2021–22 season on loan to Mansfield Town of League Two and the second half of the following season on loan to National League club Bromley. He was born in England, and has represented Wales at levels up to under-21.

Tom Naylor (born 28 June 1991) is an English professional footballer who plays as either a defensive midfielder or a centre-back for EFL League Two club Chesterfield. He has previously played for Mansfield Town, Belper Town, Alfreton Town, Bradford City and Grimsby Town.

Tom Mark Pearce (born 12 April 1998) is an English footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for EFL League Two club Chesterfield. On Deadline Day in Summer 2019, Tom Pearce signed a three-year-deal with Wigan Athletic for an undisclosed fee. He scored his first goal for Wigan in an EFL Trophy tie against Port Vale on 6 October 2020.
William Dickson (born 25 November 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Chesterfield.
Zachary Hemming (born 7 March 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for League Two club Chesterfield.
